data.name: Racceteers
data.detailed_description:
Racceteers is a chaotic couch co-op delivery game for two to four players. Work with your fellow raccoons to prepare and deliver packages—quietly and discreetly, without letting humans discover who you are. But be careful. If you fail to meet your goals on time, you’ll be fired!

An emergency has been declared in the raccoon village at Las Basuras. There are too many raccoons and not enough litter, so it’s time for you to carve out a new path. In Racceteers, players must learn how to survive in the cruel, cold human world and set out on a journey to earn the promotion needed to rise above all other raccoons.

Enjoy a fast-paced local co-op experience for two to four players. Ship a variety of packages and work together to earn a promotion from your demanding, hard-to-please boss!

A RACCOONIC QUEST

Las Basuras is your proud territory, but it is becoming more dangerous by the day. Push through countless human obstacles and acts of interference, and take part in an epic journey that tests cooperation and teamwork to their limits.

WORK TOGETHER

Need a paw? To navigate the chaotic human world where everything changes daily, help from your fellow raccoons is essential. Support one another, divide the work, travel across the city, and deliver packages together.

SIMPLE CONTROLS WITH CHALLENGES

Racceteers is easy for anyone to pick up, but surviving sudden crisis situations requires the most cooperative raccoons. Only true teamwork will lead you to victory.
